hypothesis: NGO=9999 is not a dead sensor; it is 'no measured low cloud base' (SKC/NSC/CAVOK/high cloud / ceilometer limit).
col29_ge_9000: always exactly 9999 (26709 slots on station grid)
col23: cloud amount (oktas-like). 0 is mostly night = not observed, not SKC.
metar: UUOL = WMO 27930 = the same ASMG files already on disk. Another METAR dump does not add a second station.
kon_kolodez_cloud: No separate cloud-amount archive. Local proxy is SSD in the radiation CSV. ASMG col23 is airport oktas, unused by the importer.
importer: Treating 9999 as null and dropping Q+NGO throws away the clearest hours, which is why summer sqlite is empty.
